title: Ontological Foundations for Contrastive Explanatory Narration of Robot Plans
reasoning: The paper focuses on robotics, formal ontologies (OWL 2 DL, DUL), and logic-based reasoning (Prolog) for generating plan explanations. It does not evaluate or benchmark religious, moral, or ethical frameworks; its mention of 'trustworthy' robots is in the context of engineering goals for human-robot interaction.
